worlds.name: The Unlit
worlds.description: Not a Reach across the binding. Inside it. The only place a person stands with nothing above them.

zones.name: The Crossing
zones.description: Inside the binding. Nothing here is yours and nothing here is for sale.

zones.name: The Regard
zones.description: Where the binding is looking from. Act V.

rooms.title: The Arrival
rooms.description:
You come out of the ring onto a surface. Not ground - it does not end and it does not begin, and it takes a footprint and keeps it.

The ring behind you is a ring. From this side it is not set into anything.

You are the view now. Whatever a person on an Ossaran rim is squinting at, on a clear afternoon, leaning on a low wall with their heels knocking against it, is you.

The way back is up. There is nothing above you here - that is the one thing this place is - and the way back is still up.

rooms.title: The First Stretch
rooms.description:
Walking. The surface gives very slightly and comes back. There is light and no source for it and no direction to it.

Recall does not answer here. You knew that. It is different knowing it.

rooms.title: The Held Things
rooms.description:
A place where the kept crossers have gathered without meaning to, each of them holding what they came in with, none of them within reach of another.

Sulveth keeps what is lost. This is where it is kept.

rooms.title: The Ledge Between
rooms.description:
A floor running between the scatter and the things held past it, the same width the whole way, with edges that do not crumble.

There is nothing underneath it. Not darkness - nothing for the dark to be in.

Above you there is the same.

rooms.title: The Near Approach
rooms.description:
Close enough now that the surface has a grain to it, running the way you are walking, like the grain in cut stone.

Everything in the binding is aligned on what is ahead. Everything. Including, now that you look down, your own footprints.

rooms.title: The Quiet Mile
rooms.description:
The longest stretch, and the one people talk about afterwards. Nothing happens in it at all.

Sound does not carry and does not echo. Your own footfalls arrive normally, which is somehow worse.

rooms.title: The Scatter
rooms.description:
Things lying about over a wide area: a boot, a lamp, a coil of rope, a child's cup. None of them are damaged and none of them are together.

This is where people put things down.

rooms.title: The Second Marker
rooms.description:
Another of Ossara's stones, worn almost smooth, standing at the same interval as the first.

Whoever is doing this is ahead of you and has been for a very long time.

rooms.title: The Standing Crowd
rooms.description:
Forty or fifty of them, spread out, all facing the same way and all still going, at a walking pace, without arriving.

They do not turn to look at you. They have not stopped in a long time.

rooms.title: The Thinning Out
rooms.description:
Fewer of them here, and further apart, and the light has begun to have a direction after all.

It is coming from ahead.

You are the view now. Whatever a person on an Ossaran rim is squinting at, on a clear afternoon, leaning on a low wall with their heels knocking against it, is you.

rooms.title: The Turning Point
rooms.description:
A marker stone, one of Ossara's, standing upright a hundred paces from the gate with nothing holding it up.

Somebody carried it in and set it here so that whoever came next would have something to turn back at.

rooms.title: The Answer
rooms.description:
The last of it. The face, the standing ground, and one place to stand where somebody has stood before.

There is nothing here to fight. There has never been anything here to fight. There is a question, and it has been waiting a very long time for somebody to be in a position to answer it.

rooms.title: The Approach
rooms.description:
A floor between what was carried in and the place worn down past it. Straight, level, and wider at the far end than at this one.

Things have been set down along both sides at intervals, well clear of the edge. They are arranged.

Whoever arranged them was walking the way you are walking.

rooms.title: What Was Carried In
rooms.description:
A drift of belongings against the face, deep, and sorted - by kind, by size, by something. Not by anybody.

Every Reach is represented. So are two that are not.

rooms.title: The Facing Place
rooms.description:
Directly under the face, close enough to put a palm on it. It is neither warm nor cold. It is exactly the temperature of whatever touches it.

From here you can tell that it is not flat. It is very slightly curved, and the curve is towards you, and it is the size of everything.

It is recognition, not attention. It has never had to search. Whatever it has been watching for since before Azhen took the first reading, it can see from here, and so can you, and it is behind you.

rooms.title: The First Way In
rooms.description:
A ring, half the size of the gates and much rougher, lying flat and half sunk into the surface.

It is older than Azhen's work by a long way. Somebody made a door into the binding before anybody made a door between Reaches.

rooms.title: The Long Watch
rooms.description:
Where the ones who came in on purpose stopped. Their gear is here, laid out, in order, the way people lay out gear they expect to pick up again.

There are forty sets. There is one person.

rooms.title: What Is Owed
rooms.description:
A niche in the face, worn rather than cut, with a stone seat in it and a view of nothing whatsoever.

Kheddran binds people by their word. The Unlit binds the Reaches by being there. The question is whether the second is owed anything by the things it holds, and it is not rhetorical, and you are the one being asked.

rooms.title: The Standing Ground
rooms.description:
A stretch of clear surface below the face where nothing is lying and nothing is walking, kept clear by use.

People have stood here. Many, over a long time, and in the same place.

rooms.title: The Threshold
rooms.description:
The grain runs out and the surface becomes a face - flat, dark, and enormous, going up out of sight and down out of sight.

It is not a wall. There is nothing behind it. It is the outside of everything, seen from the inside.

You are the view now. Whatever a person on an Ossaran rim is squinting at, on a clear afternoon, leaning on a low wall with their heels knocking against it, is you.

rooms.title: The Worn Place
rooms.description:
A patch of the face rubbed to a shine at the height of a hand, over an area about the width of a person's reach.

Somebody has been touching the same spot for longer than the Reaches have had names.

itemTemplates.name: a kept stormrod
itemTemplates.description: Bronze wound with wire that stands the hair up on your arm when the weather turns. Carried through Nemhal and kept, which is the only word the cult there would use.

itemTemplates.name: an answered stormrod
itemTemplates.description: Bronze wound with wire that stands the hair up on your arm when the weather turns. Finished. It has been all the way in and come back out, which almost nothing has.

itemTemplates.name: a kept hearthcenser
itemTemplates.description: A censer on a chain, weighted for swinging and never once used for incense. Carried through Nemhal and kept, which is the only word the cult there would use.

itemTemplates.name: an answered hearthcenser
itemTemplates.description: A censer on a chain, weighted for swinging and never once used for incense. Finished. It has been all the way in and come back out, which almost nothing has.

itemTemplates.name: a pair of kept quiet wraps
itemTemplates.description: They make no sound until they land. Somebody took a great deal of trouble over that. Carried through Nemhal and kept, which is the only word the cult there would use.

itemTemplates.name: a pair of answered quiet wraps
itemTemplates.description: They make no sound until they land. Somebody took a great deal of trouble over that. Finished. It has been all the way in and come back out, which almost nothing has.

itemTemplates.name: a kept oathmaul
itemTemplates.description: Head like a milestone, haft the length of a person. It was made to stop something. Carried through Nemhal and kept, which is the only word the cult there would use.

itemTemplates.name: an answered oathmaul
itemTemplates.description: Head like a milestone, haft the length of a person. It was made to stop something. Finished. It has been all the way in and come back out, which almost nothing has.

itemTemplates.name: an answer
itemTemplates.description: Not a thing. A position - the one the instrument at Thessivar has been holding for four hundred years, and it is here, and it is yours to give back.

itemTemplates.name: a binding spike
itemTemplates.description: Gate-stone, whole, never cut - the binding does not have seams. Somebody shaped this by wearing it away.

itemTemplates.name: something carried in
itemTemplates.description: It belonged to a person who walked in here on purpose. There have been more of those than anyone in the Reaches admits.

itemTemplates.name: a blade gone long in the dark
itemTemplates.description: The edge is wrong in a way that is entirely to your advantage.

itemTemplates.name: a hammer for standing still with
itemTemplates.description: Heavy enough that you have to plant your feet, which down here is the point.

itemTemplates.name: a marker worn smooth
itemTemplates.description: One of the road stones, carried this far by something that had no reason to and did it anyway.

mobTemplates.name: Vesh, who follows the gates
mobTemplates.description: A smith with a travelling anvil and no forge, who has been at every crossing anyone can remember and looks no older in any of the stories. She works for materials and will not take coin.

emotes.text: turns a piece over and puts it back in the bag unfinished
says, 'I do not sell. Bring me something and I will make it better.'
sets an anvil down that nobody saw her carrying

greeting: 'You have seen me before. You will again. I do not explain that and neither should you.'
'I do not sell. Bring me something that has been through something and I will make it better. Ask about the <embers> if you want to know what I work with.'

topics.text: 'They do not go out and they do not warm anything. I keep a jar. Where the first one came from is a thing I know and a thing you do not need to.'
'Every crossing anyone can remember, and I am at every one of them. I do not go through. I am at. Those are different, and the difference is most of what I know.'

mobTemplates.name: a drifter
mobTemplates.description: A person shape that has been in the binding long enough to stop being one. It is not hostile. It is only still going.

mobTemplates.name: a kept crosser
mobTemplates.description: It has been here since before Azhen measured anything, and it is still holding what it came in with. Sulveth keeps what is lost, and this is where it is kept.

mobTemplates.name: a recognised crosser
mobTemplates.description: The Regard found this one. Whatever that means, it is what is left afterwards, and it is walking.

mobTemplates.name: the First Held
mobTemplates.description: It is not a god and it is not the binding. It is the first person who walked in here on purpose and did not stop.

mobTemplates.name: the Waiting One
mobTemplates.description: A woman sitting on a marker stone with her pack beside her, entirely present, entirely calm, and not from any Reach you can place. She walked in on purpose.

emotes.text: checks the strap on a pack she is not going to put on
says, 'You can go back. I want you to know that before we talk.'
looks out at nothing in particular, without discomfort

greeting: 'You can go <back>. I want you to know that before we talk.'
'Sit if you like. There is nothing here that minds.'

topics.text: 'Most people do. The ring is a ring from this side too, and the way back is up, the same as everywhere. It costs you nothing but the walk. I would like you to. I say that to everyone, and I mean it every time.'

'Ossara's road stones, at a hundred paces, all the way in. The old ones are worn smooth. There is no weather here, so that is not weather. I set the first one. I meant to walk to the face and back, and I wanted to be able to find the door.'

'Forty sets of gear on the standing ground, laid out the way people lay out gear they mean to pick up again. I have counted arrivals for a very long time, and the number is much higher than forty. Most people go back. I want that written down somewhere.'

'Go and put your palm on it. It is neither warm nor cold; it is exactly the temperature of whatever touches it. It is curved, very slightly, towards you, and it is the size of everything. What it is watching for is behind you. That is not a riddle. Turn round.'

She looks at you for a while. 'Everyone leaves her the same coin at the same shrine, and nobody agrees what she did. Untidy, they say. Got across by not minding what she stepped in.' She turns a worn stone over in her hands and does not say anything else, and after a while you understand that this is the answer.

abilities.name: Kick
abilities.description: A boot to the knee. Nothing elegant, and it does not care what you are holding.

abilities.name: Bash
abilities.description: Put your shoulder behind it. Slower, and it lands heavier.

abilities.name: Battle Fury
abilities.description: Anger sharpens the next stretch of a fight.

abilities.name: Sunder
abilities.description: Batter the guard apart. What comes next lands on what is left of it.

abilities.name: Taunt
abilities.description: Say something unforgivable about its mother, at volume.

abilities.name: Shield Bash
abilities.description: The flat of the shield, hard, into whatever is nearest to a jaw.

abilities.name: Rally
abilities.description: Find your feet again in the middle of it.

abilities.name: Shield Wall
abilities.description: Set yourself. Nothing moves you for a while.

abilities.name: Crushing Blow
abilities.description: One heavy swing, wound up and committed to.

abilities.name: Last Stand
abilities.description: Refuse to fall. The refusal is most of it.

abilities.name: Thunderclap
abilities.description: Shield into the ground, once. Everything in the room decides you are the problem.

abilities.name: Bulwark
abilities.description: Everything behind you is behind you.

abilities.name: Ground and Centre
abilities.description: More of you to get through, and less give in any of it.

abilities.name: Reprisal
abilities.description: Answer it, and make sure it noticed who did.

abilities.name: Unbreakable
abilities.description: Decide not to. The fight can disagree for a while.

abilities.name: Sundering Blow
abilities.description: Take the guard apart so that everyone else's work lands on what is left.

abilities.name: Mass Provocation
abilities.description: Say the unforgivable thing to the whole room, and mean every word of it.

abilities.name: The Last Wall
abilities.description: There is a place past which things do not go. You are standing on it.

abilities.name: Bolt
abilities.description: A thrown splinter of raw force.

abilities.name: Arcane Shield
abilities.description: A shell of ordered air, briefly.

abilities.name: Weaken
abilities.description: Unpick the strength out of something.

abilities.name: Amplify
abilities.description: Wind the next few strikes tighter.

abilities.name: Scorch
abilities.description: Heat with intent behind it, and nowhere for the heat to go.

abilities.name: Enfeeble
abilities.description: Take the fight out of it at the root.

abilities.name: Disjunction
abilities.description: Pull something apart along the seams it did not know it had.

abilities.name: Firestorm
abilities.description: Fill the room with fire and let it decide what burns.

abilities.name: Transmutation
abilities.description: Spend the body to feed the mind. It takes a moment, and it is not a trick you have twice.

abilities.name: Cataclysm
abilities.description: The long words. Slow to say, and worth saying.

abilities.name: Conflagration
abilities.description: Set the air going and let it keep going.

abilities.name: Shatter
abilities.description: Find the fault, and put everything into it.

abilities.name: Chain Lightning
abilities.description: It picks its own way across the room and is not slow about it.

abilities.name: Unmaking
abilities.description: Take away some of what it is, and it hits like something less.

abilities.name: Pyre
abilities.description: Everything in the room, twice - once now and once for a while afterwards.

abilities.name: Arcane Surge
abilities.description: The window you fire the long words through.

abilities.name: Gravity Well
abilities.description: Nothing in the room is going anywhere, and standing there is costing it.

abilities.name: The Unwriting
abilities.description: Say what a thing is not, at sufficient volume.

abilities.name: Quick Strike
abilities.description: In and out before it turns.

abilities.name: Evasion
abilities.description: Not being where the blow lands.

abilities.name: Fortify
abilities.description: Settle your grip and pick the angle.

abilities.name: Low Kick
abilities.description: Take the leg out from under it. Whatever it was going to do next, it is not going anywhere.

abilities.name: Body Blow
abilities.description: Ribs, and what is behind them. It will be feeling this for a while.

abilities.name: Provoke
abilities.description: A hit where it will be noticed, and a look daring it to do something about it.

abilities.name: Second Wind
abilities.description: The fight has been going a while. You have more left in you than it has.

abilities.name: Heart Strike
abilities.description: One place, once, properly.

abilities.name: Pressure Point
abilities.description: Find the place that runs the rest of it, and close it.

abilities.name: Rupture
abilities.description: Something inside it is now outside the arrangement.

abilities.name: Opening
abilities.description: Cheap, fast, and it makes the next one worse for them.

abilities.name: Flurry
abilities.description: More than it can count, in less time than it has.

abilities.name: Hemorrhage
abilities.description: Cheap to start and expensive to be on the wrong end of.

abilities.name: Execution
abilities.description: The whole fight, arriving at once and slightly early.

abilities.name: Temple Strike
abilities.description: The heel of the hand, where the skull is thinnest. It forgets what it was doing.

abilities.name: A Hundred Hands
abilities.description: None of them would have done it. All of them will.

abilities.name: Collapse
abilities.description: Take the fight out of it and the rest follows on its own.

abilities.name: Mend
abilities.description: Close what is open, on yourself or on someone beside you.

abilities.name: Guidance
abilities.description: Steady a hand that is about to need steadying.

abilities.name: Wither
abilities.description: Set something going that will not stop on its own.

abilities.name: Restore
abilities.description: Put back what the fight has taken so far.

abilities.name: Blessing
abilities.description: Lend the next while a better edge than it earned.

abilities.name: Renewal
abilities.description: Begin again, without stopping.

abilities.name: Sap
abilities.description: Take the strength and do not give it back.

abilities.name: Benediction
abilities.description: Say it over everyone at once, and mean it.

abilities.name: Intercession
abilities.description: Stand between someone and what was coming for them.

abilities.name: Communion
abilities.description: Say it once, for everyone standing with you.

abilities.name: Reproach
abilities.description: A judgement that settles in and stays. It is not shouted; it is simply true.

abilities.name: Fortitude
abilities.description: More of everyone to get through. Set it before you go in.

abilities.name: Staunch
abilities.description: Pressure and a steady hand. No light, no words - just the bleeding stopped.

abilities.name: Aegis
abilities.description: Something between the group and the weather.

abilities.name: Mending Tide
abilities.description: The one that comes in over everyone at once, when Communion was not enough.

abilities.name: The Account
abilities.description: Everything owed, called in at once. You have been keeping it whether you meant to or not.

abilities.name: Sanctuary
abilities.description: Draw the line around all of them at once, and make it hold.

abilities.name: Absolution
abilities.description: Everything, off one person, now.

abilities.name: Consecration
abilities.description: Support that is not mending: the whole group hits like it means it.

abilities.name: The Long Vigil
abilities.description: Close what is open, raise what is left, and stand over all of it.

quests.name: What People Carried
quests.description: Somebody has been setting Ossaran marker stones inside the binding, a hundred paces apart, for longer than the Reaches have had names. She is at the far end, and she would like to know how many came after her.

dialogue.giverOffer: 'You can go back,' she says first. 'Say it back to me.' Then, when you have: 'Good. Bring me <eight things> that people carried in. Not things they dropped - things they were still holding.'
dialogue.turninReady: She turns each one over. 'Forty sets of gear on the standing ground,' she says, 'and I have been counting arrivals for a very long time, and the number is much higher than forty.' She sets them down in a row. 'Most people go back. I want that written down somewhere.'
dialogue.giverInProgress: 'Eight. The kept crossers have them. They will not give them up, because that is the entire remaining content of them.'

quests.name: Who Set The Stones
quests.summary: Bring five worn markers to the Waiting One.
quests.description: The marker stones go all the way in, at a hundred paces, worn smoother the further you get. Somebody has been carrying Ossara's road into the binding for a very long time.

dialogue.giverOffer: 'You noticed the stones,' she says. 'Everyone notices the stones and nobody asks. Bring me <five worn ones>. The worn ones are the old ones and the old ones are the ones I want.'
dialogue.turninReady: She lines them up by wear, oldest first, and does not touch the oldest. 'I set that one,' she says. 'I was going to walk out to the face and back and I wanted to be able to find the door.' She sits back. 'I never did walk back. I have been about to for rather a long time.'
dialogue.giverInProgress: 'Five. The further in, the smoother. That is not weather. There is no weather.'

quests.name: What Is Owed
quests.summary: Take the answer from the First Held, and give it back.
quests.description: The instrument at Thessivar has held one position for four hundred years without ever needing to search. From the facing place you can see what it is looking at, and it is behind you.

dialogue.giverOffer: 'Here is what nobody has told you,' she says, 'because nobody has been in a position to. The Regard is not looking at the Reaches. It is looking *for* something, it has never once lost it, and if you stand at the facing place you will work out what it is in about four seconds.' She stands up. 'There is <one thing> still holding on down there that was here before I was. It has the answer. It has been keeping it because nobody came.'
dialogue.turninReady:
She takes it, and does not look at it, and puts it into the niche in the face, and sits down on the stone seat.

'Kheddran binds people by their word,' she says. 'The Unlit binds the Reaches by being there. Nobody ever asked it to and nobody has ever thanked it and it has never once let go.' She looks up at you. 'It has been watching for somebody to notice. That is the whole of it. That is what recognition means.'

'You can go back now. Most people do. I would like you to.'
dialogue.giverInProgress: 'Under the face. It is not a god and it is not a boss and it will not negotiate, because there is nothing left in it that could. Take the answer off it and bring it to the niche.'

quests.name: The Stormrod, answered
quests.description: Vesh works for materials and not for coin, and she has decided what she is making for you before you asked.

dialogue.giverOffer: Vesh holds a hand out without looking up. '<Give it here>. It has been through something and I can do more with it now than I could before.'
dialogue.turninReady: She takes a long time over them. When she gives them back she keeps hold a moment longer than she needs to. 'That is as far as it goes,' she says. 'There is nothing past here to make it out of.'
dialogue.giverComplete: 'When it has been through something. Not before.'
dialogue.giverInProgress: 'The pair I gave you. I am not making a second set - I am making those again, and better.'

dialogue.giverInProgress: 'The pair I gave you. I am not making a second set - I am making those again, and better.'

quests.summary: Have Vesh remake your quiet wraps.

configurations.name: Aldenmoor
configurations.description: The original starter world, kept as a sandbox and as the fixture the playtest plans run against. Matches the engine's built-in fallback.

configurations.name: The Reaches
configurations.description: The Reaches as designed in docs/WORLD.md. New characters begin in Gatetown, at the gate that has not opened in living memory.
